transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... well, I guess it's because of my job. I help plan events, so lately I've had to be more... visible, I guess. In front of people. And... I don't know, there's just this one part of my face that looks really uneven. I just keep staring at it in all the photos from work. People say they don't really see it, but... I just can't stop looking at it.
Can you tell me more about how this uneven part of your face makes you feel emotionally?
Um... I don't really know. It just... bothers me, I guess. I'm not really sure how to explain it. It just makes me feel... bad.
Has this concern about your face made it hard for you to do your job or interact with others, or has it been on your mind a lot even when you're not at work?

Um... yeah, I guess. It's... it's been getting in the way at work. Like, I actually missed part of a planning deadline recently. I just... I spent way too much time dealing with how I looked in the event materials. And now... I don't know, just doing vendor calls or getting ready for meetings... it all just takes me a lot longer than it should. So... yeah.
Has this concern about your face affected any parts of your life outside of work, like spending time with friends or family, or doing things you used to enjoy?
Um... I don't really know. I guess I still see people sometimes. It's just... I don't know, it's fine, I guess. I haven't really thought about it that much outside of work stuff.
Do you feel very distressed or avoid social situations because of your concerns about your face?

Um... I don't really know if I avoid things. I mean... maybe a little? But... I don't think it's that bad. I just... I don't really like going out as much, I guess. But it's... it's not like I never leave the house or anything.
Do you worry about any other parts of your body besides your face, or is your main concern just with your face?
Um... no. Not really. It's... it's just my face, mostly. I don't really think about the rest of it.
Do you feel like your concern about your face takes up a lot of your time or feels really hard to control, even when you try to focus on other things?

Um... I guess it takes up some time. Like, at work... before I have to send out pictures from an event, or if I have to get on a video call with a vendor... I kind of keep checking my phone camera. Just to see. And... I might retake photos a few times, or try to hold my head a certain way so it doesn't look as bad. Sometimes I'll ask a coworker if I look weird. It's... I don't know, it takes a while sometimes. I've fallen behind on some planning stuff because of it, I guess. But... yeah.
Outside of work, do you feel embarrassed or self-conscious about your face when you’re around others, like friends or family?

Um... I guess so. Sometimes. I just... I don't really like people looking at me too closely. So I try to just blend in, or... I don't know, sit in the back. But I don't really talk about it with them.
Has your concern about how your face looks ever caused you to stop doing things you used to do, or to feel like you can't function normally in your daily life?

Um... well, like I said, I missed part of a deadline recently. I just... I spent too long trying to fix how I looked in the materials for the event. And... I don't know, getting ready for vendor calls and meetings just takes me a lot longer now. So... yeah, I guess it affects things.
Do you find yourself thinking about how your face looks for long periods of time, even when you're not at work or in social situations, like when you're alone at home?
Um... I don't think so. Not really. When I'm just home by myself, I... I don't know, I guess I don't really focus on it as much. It's mostly just... when other people are going to see me. So... no.
Has your concern about your face ever caused problems in your relationships with others, or made it hard for you to function in situations outside of work, like spending time with friends or family?

Um... not really, no. I mean, my friends and family don't really know about it. I just... I keep it to myself. I still see them, I just... I don't know, I guess I just try not to draw attention to myself when we hang out. But we don't fight about it or anything.
